title: Regular-module comparison for a ring-sheaf pushout
statement: Let f:U → X be any scheme morphism, A=f_*O_U, r₀:f⁻¹O_X → O_U and t₀:f⁻¹O_X → f⁻¹A the canonical maps, and b:O_U → B, t:f⁻¹A → B a pushout of them in commutative-ring sheaves. There exists an O_U-module isomorphism e:f^*(f_*O_U) ≅ Res_b(B), where B is its regular module. For every base open V and section d of O_U over f⁻¹V, e carries the canonical module pullback unit of d to t(η_A(d)), with η_A the ring inverse-image unit. There is no affine hypothesis. Pullback and its unit are [def-pc-module-pullback] and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and inverse-image modules use [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module].

source.document: Stacks Project, Morphisms and Sheaves on Spaces
source.place: Tag 01SB, construction of h and elucidation; Tag 008A, sheafified extension of scalars

proof.text: Let A=f_*O_U and G be its regular module. Restriction along O_X→A is definitionally the pushforward of the regular O_U module. Apply affine_module_tensor_baseChange to G and obtain P, its object equality, the cancellation natural isomorphism κ and its canonical-unit formula. No affine hypothesis is used.
Apply exists_inverseImage_regularModule_iso to f and A. This yields the IA-linear regular-module comparison q, whose hom carries the additive inverse-image unit to the ring inverse-image unit.

For a ring-sheaf map t:IA→B, use the sectionwise tensor right-unitor AlgebraTensorModule.rid, with formula z tensor a ↦ z*t(a). Naturality on one tensor a follows from naturality of t, and ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext gives naturality on all tensors. PresheafOfModules.isoMk and the module sheafification functor turn these sectionwise isomorphisms into a sheaf-module isomorphism. The sheafification counit is invertible since the regular B-module is already a sheaf; the right triangle identity gives the formula after sheafification. Extension of q is obtained by sectionwise extendScalars.mapIso and sheafification; unit naturality supplies its tensor formula.

Compose κ inverse with the restriction along b of the object equality for P and the two regular-module isomorphisms. For each V and d, the κ-unit formula gives the sheafification of 1 tensor η_Ab(d). Naturality of the extended q turns this into 1 tensor q(η_Ab(d)). The regular extension comparison maps it to 1*t(q(η_Ab(d)))=t(η_ring(d)). This is the required section formula for the same isomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image of regular ring module is regular inverse image ring module; extending scalars gives regular target ring module

mathlib_searches.results: mapFreeIso and overMapUnitIso found. The former assumes a unit comparison; the latter is restriction to a slice. Neither identifies tensor pullback of a pushforward regular module with a pushout ring regular module.

No matching comparison in Mathlib ModuleCat and Topology/Sheaves sources. Library has cancellation but not its regular-module specialization. blueprint_refs.py search regular module returned zero blueprint nodes.
